mainEntity.name: What is an interview scheduling template?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a structured document used to plan and track candidate interview appointments, including date, time, interviewer, format, location and status.

mainEntity.name: Can the template support bulk hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It can be adapted for multiple candidates, roles and interviewers when columns and status definitions stay consistent.

mainEntity.name: Does the template automatically send invitations?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Automated invitations require separately implemented functionality. The template organises scheduling details only.

mainEntity.name: Can employers use it for virtual interviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The format can include approved meeting details and time zones for telephone or video interviews.
